theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

top_news.title: Venture Capital During the AI Revolution: Masters in Business with Mamoon Hamid
top_news.summary: Barry sits down with Kleiner Perkins Partner, Mamoon Hamid. They discuss Mamoon's thoughts on the AI revolution and his approach to early AI investing.  Mamoon also breaks down how he became an early investor in giants like Slack, Figma, and how Kleiner Perkins assesses the investments they missed. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Oil Is Little Changed as Persian Gulf Flows Near Pre-War Levels
top_news.summary: Oil prices were little changed in thin trading as the recovery of Persian Gulf flows fomented a new surplus in key parts of the global market.

top_news.title: CPP Invests $1.75 Billion in EQT’s AI Buildout
top_news.summary: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board will invest $1.75 billion to support EQT AB’s artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout, it announced Friday.

top_news.title: ECB’s Lagarde Will Attend Next Week’s Ecofin Instead of Vujcic
top_news.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will be attending next week’s meeting of European Union finance ministers in Brussels instead of her vice president.

top_news.title: ECB’s Nagel Stresses Need for Vigilance at Next Rate Decision
top_news.summary: The European Central Bank should stay watchful for inflation risks and keep its options open, Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said.

top_news.title: European Stocks Rally to Cap Best Week Since May: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks rose as the latest round of jitters about the artificial-intelligence trade subsided, with Europe’s benchmark rising to an all-time high. The dollar touched a two-week low while gold extended gains.

top_news.title: Argentina Pushes $6 Billion in Repo Maturities Past Election
top_news.summary: Argentina’s central bank extended maturities worth $6 billion on its repurchase agreements — or repos — to ease the government debt burden going into the 2027 presidential election.

top_news.title: Yen Strengthens as Traders Brace for Holiday Intervention Risk
top_news.summary: Options traders are paying up to hedge against sharp moves in the yen ahead of thin US holiday trading, as speculation grows that Japanese authorities may be less predictable in how they intervene to support the currency.

top_news.title: Defense Sector to Remain Dynamic: Euronext CEO Boujnah
top_news.summary: Euronext CEO Stephane Boujnah says the defense sector will remain dynamic as Europe ramps up military spending and investors continue to back the industry. He also discusses European IPOs, capital markets reform, exchange consolidation and the region's technology ecosystem. He speaks with Bloomberg's Caroline Connan at the Aix-en-Provence Economic Forum in France. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: OPEC Output Surged in June as Hormuz Flows Jumped, Survey Shows
top_news.summary: OPEC’s crude oil production surged last month as Persian Gulf members restored exports through the Strait of Hormuz amid a peace accord between the US and Iran, according to a Bloomberg survey.
